_about: Pictures on the guide pages. 'images' gives each picture its alt text; 'guides' puts a picture under a step (step numbers start at 1). The files and their sizes come from scripts/guide-images/capture.py (src/data/guide-image-files.json). Wording of the steps stays in guides.json.

images.new-site: Aero's New site page with three choices: Upload HTML, From Claude or ChatGPT, and From Figma.
images.new-site-prompt: New site, From Claude or ChatGPT: the publish prompt with a Copy prompt button. The key is added when you copy it.
images.new-site-upload: New site, Upload HTML: a drop area for a folder or zip, an optional name, and Publish.
images.new-site-figma: New site, From Figma, with a Phone breakpoint added: the Example link on Desktop, and a Phone row that uses the same link until you give it its own.
images.new-test: Aero's New test page with four choices: Upload HTML, From Claude or ChatGPT, From Figma, and One of your sites.
images.site-page: A site's page in Aero, Example data: the address marked Live, the Site, Versions and Analytics tabs, a preview with Open live and Refresh, and Settings beside it.
images.versions: The Versions tab of an Example site: each version with its date and what changed, the live one marked Live and a newer draft above it.
images.analytics: The Analytics tab of an Example site: visitors, visits, pageviews and visit time over 7 days, a chart, and where visitors came from, their countries and devices.
images.password: The Password setting on a site's page: a switch and a field to choose a password.
images.domain: The Your own domain setting, with app.example.com typed in, a Connect button and the A and CNAME records to add with your registrar.
images.test-link: A test's link with a Copy button, and the Taking new sessions switch that opens or closes it.
images.test-setup: A test's Setup tab, Example data: what testers open, then two tasks and a field to add another.
images.task-edit: Editing a task: the task and an optional description, with Cancel and Save.
images.sessions: A test's Sessions tab, Example data: each session with the tester, how many issues and other findings, its length and status.
images.review-watch: A session in Watch view, Example data: the recording of the Example shop, the timeline with tasks and findings, and the transcript beside it.
images.review-timeline: The session timeline: play controls, task blocks, a faint waveform with findings marked on it, and filters for issues, confusion, requests and what worked well.
images.review-transcript: The Transcript tab of a session, Example data: timed lines grouped by task, with the findings tagged under the lines they came from.
images.review-arriving: A session whose transcript is still arriving: a short note and grey placeholder lines, and the recording ready to watch.
images.insights: The Insights tab of an Example test: a summary, then what to fix first, each with its severity, a suggested fix, how many testers and their quotes.
images.new-site-figma-link: New site, From Figma: an Example prototype link pasted into the All screens row, with Add breakpoint under it.
images.review-lanes: The timeline in Lanes view: tasks, the tester's voice and quotes each on their own row, then one row per kind of finding.
images.site-update: The Update section of a site's page: Drop files with Choose files, Ask Claude or ChatGPT with Get prompt, and Use a Figma link with Switch source.
images.publish-dialog: The dialog after dropping files: Add 3 files, the files listed, the Publish straight away switch, Cancel and Publish.
images.tester-allow: What a tester sees: the Allow recording card with a Microphone row that is on and a Screen recording row with Allow, and the hint to pick this tab in Chrome's list.
